history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration remind concerned entities to report long-vacant positions funded by the regular budget in the budget documentation, as required in the budget guide.
history.administration_response: The Programme Planning and Budget Division considers this recommendation to be implemented. As demonstrated in paragraph 7 of the budget guide for the proposed programme budget for 2026, issued in January 2025 and in template 2 for the supplementary information to the budget fascicle, the Division emphasized the need for full disclosure, during the preparation of the budget fascicle, of information on long-vacant posts. Evidence was provided by the Division to entities for the preparation of the supplementary information to the budget fascicle. The file with the list of long- vacant posts is extracted, prepared by the Division and provided to entities for confirmation, in order to ensure that the information is complete. On the basis of the supporting documentation provided, the Division respectfully requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that, under paragraph 10 (c) of the budget guide for the proposed programme budget for 2026, entities are required to report on the findings of the review of all actual and anticipated vacant posts (as at 31 March 2025), and to provide eventual justification for the continued need for posts that have been vacant for two or more years, and that the Programme Planning and Budget Division has provided to entities by email the list of long-vacant positions in order to ensure that the report is complete, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
